name: RainReady Waterproof Jacket
description: A lightweight waterproof jacket with a hood and sealed seams for rainy day hikes. Packs into its own pocket.

name: Summit Insulated Jacket
description: A warm insulated jacket for cold mountain mornings and winter camping. Wind resistant with a roomy hood.

name: Breeze Windbreaker
description: A light windbreaker jacket for breezy walks and trail runs. Breathable fabric for dry weather; not waterproof.

name: Campfire Fleece Jacket
description: A soft fleece jacket for cool evenings at the campsite. Comfortable as a middle layer under a rain shell.

name: TrailGrip Hiking Boots
description: Waterproof hiking boots with ankle support and grippy soles for muddy trails and wet rocks.

name: Desert Trek Boots
description: Breathable hiking boots for hot and dry trails. Lightweight mesh panels help feet stay cool.

name: SnowPath Winter Boots
description: Insulated winter boots with a waterproof shell and deep tread for snowy paths.

name: DayWalk Trail Shoes
description: Low cut walking shoes for easy trails and everyday adventures. Flexible soles and a cushioned heel.

name: DayTrip 20L Backpack
description: A compact backpack for short hikes with a bottle pocket and space for lunch, a rain layer, and a map.

name: Weekend 40L Backpack
description: A backpack for overnight trips with a padded hip belt, adjustable straps, and a removable rain cover.

name: Expedition 65L Backpack
description: A large backpack for multi day treks with room for a sleeping bag, cooking gear, and extra layers.

name: TrailRun Hydration Pack
description: A small pack with a two liter water reservoir for trail running and fast hikes. Includes reflective details.

name: DuoTrail Two Person Tent
description: A compact two person tent with a rainfly and mesh ventilation for weekend backpacking trips.

name: FamilyCamp Four Person Tent
description: A roomy four person tent with two doors and a covered porch for family camping at the campground.

name: SoloLight One Person Tent
description: A lightweight one person tent for solo hikers who want to carry less on longer trails.

name: QuickPitch Pop Up Tent
description: A pop up tent for festivals and casual summer camping. Easy to pitch for a quick overnight stay.

name: NightTrail Headlamp
description: A rechargeable headlamp with a red light mode for setting up camp after dark and early morning walks.

name: TrailSip Insulated Bottle
description: A reusable insulated water bottle that keeps drinks cold during a long hike. Holds 750 milliliters.

name: SteadyStep Trekking Poles
description: Adjustable trekking poles for balance on steep climbs and descents. Fold down to fit in a backpack.

name: DryStash Waterproof Bag
description: A waterproof roll top bag for keeping spare clothes and electronics dry while kayaking or hiking in rain.
